items.text: Check with a doctor before starting if you have a health condition.
Never hold your breath during core holds or lifting; exhale during effort and inhale during reset.
Stop any movement immediately if you feel sharp, pinching, or radiating joint pain.
The 10-Minute Desk Emergency: 2 minutes of cat-cow and spinal twists, 3 sets of 10 chair sit-to-stands, 10 doorway chest openers, and a 4-minute brisk walk down the hall or around the block.
Goblet Squat or Chair Sit-to-Stand → Bodyweight sit-to-stand from a kitchen chair or backpack filled with books
Dumbbell or Band Romanian Deadlift → Single-leg bodyweight reach or two full water jugs held in hands
Dumbbell or Band Supported Row → Towel doorframe rows or lifting a loaded tote bag toward your hip
Standing Overhead Dumbbell Press → Pressing two full 1-liter water bottles or band overhead press
Brisk Outdoor or Treadmill Walk → Marching in place or living room pacing while reviewing flashcards
